avoid.reason: Maybelline Sky High Mascara (#9) is a major CPG brand product with strict MAP pricing, authorized retailer requirements, and no dropship-compatible supply chain; dropshipping counterfeit or unauthorized makeup creates significant legal and reputational risk.

avoid.product_type: Screenless or Branded Smart Wearables (Google Fitbit, Apple-Adjacent Devices)
avoid.reason: The Fitbit Air (#5 Sports) is a Google-branded product — dropshippers have no authorized supply chain access, face counterfeit liability, and cannot compete on price or warranty trust against the brand itself; branded electronics are universally poor dropship candidates.

avoid.product_type: Heavy or Oversized Fitness Equipment (Full Dumbbell Sets over 25 lb, Benches, Racks)
avoid.reason: While neoprene dumbbells appear in bestsellers, heavier sets exceed the 10–15 lb dropship-friendly threshold; oversized fitness equipment incurs dimensional weight shipping surcharges that compress or eliminate margins, making fulfillment economics unviable without 3PL or domestic warehousing.

avoid.product_type: Acne and Skincare Products Requiring FDA Drug Labeling (OTC Drug Claims)
avoid.reason: Products like PanOxyl Benzoyl Peroxide Wash (#10) and Nizoral Ketoconazole Shampoo (#15) are regulated OTC drugs — dropshipping requires FDA-registered facilities, compliant labeling, and authorized distribution; selling unauthorized versions risks FDA enforcement action and platform bans.

analysis.market_insights:
June 2026 is presenting a rare convergence of multiple high-velocity trend categories firing simultaneously. The K-beauty and chemical exfoliant boom shows no signs of plateauing, with at least five distinct products from these niches dominating Amazon Beauty's top-20 — this is category-level dominance, not brand-specific noise. Paired with TikTok's continued role as the primary discovery engine for skincare, dropshippers who establish credible positioning in AHA/BHA pads, hydrogel masks, and pore-care formats right now will ride a demand curve that has at least 8–12 more weeks of strong momentum before summer begins to fade. The window for mineral SPF is even shorter — act within the next 5–7 days or wait until next April.

The summer sports and outdoor category is the second major opportunity cluster. Weighted vests appearing twice in the top-10, insulated water bottles dominating two slots, and swim accessories rising sharply all point to a consumer who is spending on active summer living. The FIFA World Cup 2026 is a sleeper opportunity many dropshippers will miss — a North American-hosted tournament means the sticker/card collectibles market is 10x larger than a typical World Cup cycle. This is a 6-week sprint window with high velocity and guaranteed end date, ideal for a focused paid social campaign. Prioritize lightweight, shippable products with strong TikTok visual appeal, and avoid any category where Amazon itself is the seller.
